paper_title: FineWeb-CLaR: Culture, Language, and Region Annotations for Benchmark-Aligned Corpus Auditing
reason: 이 논문은 FineWeb과 FineWeb-2에 지역(URL 기반)과 문화 분류 주석을 붙인 코퍼스 감사용 주석 자원(FineWeb-CLaR)이다. 모델 응답을 채점하는 재사용 가능한 LLM 평가 벤치마크가 아니다. 문화 벤치마크 277종을 분류해 감사한 결과물도 기존 벤치마크의 메타데이터 조사이지 새 과제나 평가 세트가 아니다. 또한 주석 대상은 FineWeb-2의 다국어 웹 문서 전체이며, 한국어나 영어 평가 과제를 따로 정의하지 않는다. 따라서 인벤토리에 새 행이나 갱신 행으로 올릴 근거가 부족해 제외한다.

screening.paper_title: FineWeb-CLaR: Culture, Language, and Region Annotations for Benchmark-Aligned Corpus Auditing
screening.abstract: Cultural evaluation coverage and robustness in language models are difficult to diagnose because pretraining corpora and cultural benchmarks are rarely indexed with comparable metadata. Benchmarks increasingly target culturally situated phenomena at the level of languages, regions, and locale-specific practices, while web-scale corpora are usually organized only by language. A shared culture-language-region layer makes these resources comparable, enabling audits of whether a target cultural phenomenon is represented in pretraining data, evaluated by benchmarks or both. To this end, we introduce FineWeb-CLaR, a large-scale annotated dataset derived from FineWeb and FineWeb-2 that places web documents on a shared culture-language-region axis for corpus auditing and benchmark alignment. FineWeb-CLaR annotates the full 30.9B-document collection from FineWeb and FineWeb-2 with URL-derived region labels and cultural-topic provenance. Our region resolver assigns a non-empty region to 25.61% of documents (7.92B). For cultural-topic analysis, we induce locale-specific topics and project them onto the 14 leaves of the Cultural Taxonomy of Liu et al. (2025), producing Locale Topic Distributions (LTDs) for corpus-side comparison. We also annotate 277 cultural NLP benchmarks with the same taxonomy, language coverage, and region coverage. Together, these resources enable direct comparison between corpus-side pretraining evidence and benchmark-side evaluation coverage.
